description:
Read the live editor UI as a tree (controls, paths, text, state), or every visible dialog and whether one blocks input. Its paths are what summer_ui_activate takes.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/ui-tree"}

depth.description: Tree depth (engine default 4, max 32). Plain Nodes between Controls do not consume depth.

limit.description: Maximum Control nodes emitted (engine default 500, max 5000). The result carries truncated + child_count so a cut is visible.

root.description: Where to start. 'main' (default) = the whole editor chrome; 'window' = the SceneTree root incl. every sub-window; 'dock:<title|id>' = one dock (ids file_system | scene_tree | inspector, or any dock…

visible_only.description: Default true. false also emits hidden controls — readable, but summer_ui_activate refuses them with not_visible.

name: summer_ui_tree
title: Read the editor UI
